summary: Ochoco NF lookout in Grant County: an L-4 tower built in 1939, reported as 40 or 50 feet, removed or destroyed in 1968.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1968 per the register; Rex's page says destroyed that year; no description of the site today found

events.note: 40-foot treated timber L-4 tower per the register and Rex's page; a 1939 Ochoco history entry quoted by the Forest Lookouts page lists a 50-foot tower and house; a May 1939 memo mentions a one-car garage and woodshed
Burglars broke into the lookout station in October 1950 and took two lanterns; rangers were asked to check other lookouts
Register says removed in 1968; Rex's page says destroyed that year
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on June 23, 2011

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Rex's page give a 40-foot tower. A 1939 Ochoco history entry, quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, lists a 50-foot tower and house. The facts use the 40-foot figure, and the story reports both.
The register says removed in 1968; Rex's page says destroyed that year. The story reports both wordings.

notes_for_editor: No staffing dates were found for this site. No source describes what remains at the site today or whether it is reachable, so the story says so. The Ochoco history figures are cited second-hand through the Forest Lookouts page; the original was not found. The register lists a 1942 photo from the Howard Verschoor collection, but no image URL was available, so no photo is recorded. Stock photos on Alamy were not used because their licence was not checked.
